verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the Trigger.dev product or dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server and Skills let external AI assistants control Trigger.dev, and `chat.agent` is a developer building block for building your own AI chats. These are adjacent capabilities, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
